feature_under_test: Recruiting-extension bounded execution batch envelope, batch_size=32

environment.mysql: 8.4 isolated container, separate non-root migration/runtime users
environment.artifact_provider: one local Atoll daemon File Resource provider
environment.controlled_origin: ephemeral container on a Docker --internal network
environment.origin_address_class: public-shaped 11.254.x.x routed only inside the ephemeral internal network

capacity_assessment.interpretation: the extension-local batch envelope removes most per-item control-message overhead and more than doubles H2 throughput, but the measured controlled baseline remains slightly below the frozen 400K-in-8h arithmetic reference
capacity_assessment.phase_latency_interpretation: batch phase latencies are per-Attempt wall-clock observations: offer-to-accept includes waiting for the whole offer batch, start-to-terminal includes sequential execution inside one claimed batch, and terminal-to-next-offer exists only between supply batches; they are not comparable as per-item network round trips to the unbatched phase medians
capacity_assessment.projection_scope: arithmetic gap indicator only; it excludes Listing, failures, third-party latency, Browser, and remote storage

non_claims: third-party latency, throttling, CDN, or availability behavior

acceptance.reason: bounded batching closes most of the local control-plane gap, but the controlled rate remains 3.5% below the reference and external, Browser, full-shape, and long-window gates remain
